Sam: Planning to unpin runtime v2.14 -> v2.15 in eu-staging, phased. Gate with SDK check.
Aisha: Note SDK 3.2.2 required due to X-Model-Bind header change.
deploy-bot: compatibility-check --region eu-staging --runtime v2.15 --min-sdk 3.2.2
Marta: Add smoke: POST /v1/generate 1k-prefix, assert p99 < 350ms.
deploy-bot: result: 5/10 nodes report SDK 3.2.1 -> ABORT unpin.
Sam: Acknowledged. Scheduling SDK roll tonight 23:00-23:30 UTC. Will retry after.
infra-bot: rolling update scheduled for nodes n3,n6,n8 at 23:00 UTC.
Aisha: I'll draft a short note for support explaining staging remains pinned until SDK parity.
Sam: Leaving thread open; retry command when compatibility-check passes: deploy-bot retry-unpin --thread 1767779999.
